slice: explore WI-d6c086 step MEASURE - Audio8-TTS 0.1B ONNX INT8 on Apple Silicon CPU

machine.power: AC; no thermal-throttle instrumentation; other user processes not quiesced

backend.onnxruntime: 1.24.4 (bench venv; NOT the 1.27.0 obey-voice links via sherpa-onnx-go)

model.reference_voice: packaged reference_codes.npy (110 frames, Chinese reference text)

harness.why: the vendor's published onnx_runtime/ code CANNOT run these graphs: it expects a transformer slow model with per-layer cache_key_N inputs, while the published slow graph is a mamba/SSM hybrid taking cache_keys/cache_values/conv_states/ssm_states, and it does not handle slow_logits_layout=relative_semantic_then_eos
harness.protocol: N7 protocol - same two phrases as TestKokoroRealtimeFactor, warmup then median of 3
harness.rtf_definition: audio_seconds / total_synth_seconds (higher is faster; matches N7/F7)

baseline_same_session.note: re-measured 2026-08-27, NOT quoted from N7 (which printed 1.32x/1.38x on a quieter machine)

prefix_cache_experiment.detail: 43 system text tokens + 110 reference-voice frames, identical every turn

verdict.as_shipped: FAILS the N7 bar - 2.17 s for one sentence against a >1.8 s loses rule; RTF 0.68x, slower than realtime
verdict.with_prefix_cache: PASSES the bar - projected ~1.03 s per sentence, RTF ~1.44x, ahead of Kokoro's same-session 1.17x
verdict.batching_threshold_2_3x: NOT cleared in any measured or projected configuration; D009 and D010 stand
verdict.projection_warning: the with_prefix_cache line is arithmetic on measured parts (measured warm prefill + measured decode + measured codec), NOT an end-to-end measurement. Build it before believing it.

cost_decomposition_one_sentence_ms.comment: AR decode alone is 504 ms for 1.486 s of audio = 2.95x realtime. The AR loop is FAST. Prefill and codec are what fail the bar, and prefill is the cacheable one.

open: English quality unjudged - the packaged reference voice is Chinese; no English reference was registered
codec streaming/pipelining with the AR loop untested (would overlap the two largest costs)
peak RSS 2.0 GB measured vs ~0.6 GB claimed on the model card
measured against onnxruntime 1.24.4; obey-voice links 1.27.0 via sherpa-onnx-go
